zh-CN.title: 视频预览更顺手
items: 视频沉浸预览现在提供播放、暂停与进度控制，轻触画面即可显示或隐藏操作栏
聊天中的发言图片和视频现在也能查看完整影像记录

en.title: A smoother video viewer
items: Immersive video previews now include play, pause, and timeline controls with a tap-to-toggle action bar
Photos and videos embedded in shared Square posts now retain their complete media records
